t2.title: Tourism good or bad for local communities
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is tourism good or bad for local communities?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Tourism is a significant industry worldwide, but its impact on local communities is debated. I believe tourism brings both benefits and challenges.

On the positive side, tourism creates employment opportunities for local residents. Hotels, restaurants, and tour companies provide jobs that might otherwise not exist in smaller communities. Additionally, tourism revenue can fund infrastructure improvements like better roads and public facilities that benefit everyone.

Moreover, cultural exchange between tourists and locals promotes understanding and preserves traditional crafts and customs that might otherwise disappear.

However, tourism also creates problems. Popular destinations often experience overcrowding, pollution, and rising living costs that affect local residents. In some areas, housing prices increase dramatically as properties become holiday rentals, forcing locals to move elsewhere. Furthermore, traditional cultures can become commercialized and lose authenticity.

The key is sustainable tourism that balances economic benefits with community well-being. Local governments should regulate tourist numbers, ensure profits benefit residents, and protect cultural heritage.

In conclusion, tourism can benefit communities when managed responsibly, but uncontrolled tourism causes significant harm. Balance and regulation are essential.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!

Tourism… good. I like. See new things. Food good. People nice.

Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,

Tourism is good and bad. Good because money for people. And shops. But bad because too many people. It is noisy. I like my town quiet. But my friend likes tourists because she works in a shop and sells things. It is difficult.

Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Editor,

I am writing about tourism. I think tourism is both good and bad for local communities.

For example, tourism can give jobs to people. Hotels and restaurants need workers. Also, tourists spend money in shops. This is good for the economy. However, tourism can also be bad. Sometimes there are too many tourists and it is crowded. Also, prices can go up because tourists have more money. This makes it difficult for local people to buy things.

In my opinion, we need to find a balance. Tourism can be good if it is managed well. But if it is not, it can cause problems.

Sincerely,
A Student
t2.sampleB2:
Suitcases, Selfies and Souvenirs: A Blessing or a Burden?

Every summer, millions of travellers pour into towns and villages around the world. But when the tour buses roll in, is it a blessing or a burden for the people who actually live there?

There is no denying that tourism can work wonders for a local economy. It creates jobs, breathes life into small businesses, and brings in the money that pays for better roads, parks and schools. On top of that, welcoming visitors from abroad opens the door to genuine cultural exchange, and it often gives people a reason to keep age-old traditions and crafts alive.

However, there is another side to the coin. When too many tourists descend on a single spot, locals end up paying the price. Rents shoot up, the cost of living creeps higher, streets become packed, and once-quiet neighbourhoods lose their charm. Worse still, precious traditions can be turned into cheap performances just to please the crowds.

So, is tourism good or bad? In my view, it all comes down to balance. Handled responsibly, tourism can enrich a community; left unchecked, it can slowly tear it apart.

by Nodira Yusupova
t2.uzSample:
Turizm butun dunyo bo'ylab muhim sanoat hisoblanadi, ammo uning mahalliy aholiga ta'siri bahsli. Menimcha, turizm ham foyda, ham muammolarni keltirib chiqaradi.

Ijobiy tomoni shundaki, turizm mahalliy aholi uchun ish o'rinlari yaratadi. Mehmonxonalar, restoranlar va sayyohlik kompaniyalari kichik jamoalarda bo'lmasligi mumkin bo'lgan ishlarni ta'minlaydi. Bundan tashqari, turizm daromadlari barcha uchun foydali bo'lgan yaxshiroq yo'llar va jamoat inshootlari kabi infratuzilmani yaxshilashga sarflanishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, sayyohlar va mahalliy aholi o'rtasidagi madaniy almashinuv tushunishni rivojlantiradi va yo'qolib ketishi mumkin bo'lgan an'anaviy hunarmandchilik va urf-odatlarni saqlab qoladi.

Biroq, turizm muammolarni ham yaratadi. Ommabop joylar ko'pincha gavjumlik, ifloslanish va mahalliy aholiga ta'sir qiladigan turmush darajasining oshishi bilan duch keladi. Ba'zi hududlarda uy-joy narxlari mulklar dam olish uchun ijaraga berilishi sababli keskin oshadi va mahalliy aholi boshqa joyga ko'chib o'tishga majbur bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, an'anaviy madaniyatlar tijoratlashtirilishi va o'zining asl qiyofasini yo'qotishi mumkin.

Muhimi, iqtisodiy foyda va jamiyat farovonligini muvozanatlashtiradigan barqaror turizmdir. Mahalliy hukumatlar sayyohlar sonini tartibga solishi, foydaning aholiga foyda keltirishini ta'minlashi va madaniy merosni himoya qilishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, turizm mas'uliyat bilan boshqarilganda jamiyatlarga foyda keltirishi mumkin, ammo nazoratsiz turizm jiddiy zarar keltiradi. Muvozanat va tartibga solish muhim.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!

Turizm… yaxshi. Menga yoqadi. Yangi narsalarni ko'raman. Ovqat yaxshi. Odamlar yaxshi.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Turizm yaxshi ham, yomon ham. Yaxshi, chunki odamlar uchun pul. Va do'konlar uchun. Lekin yomon, chunki odamlar juda ko'p. U shovqinli. Men o'z shahrini tinch bo'lishini xohlayman. Lekin do'stim turistlarni yaxshi ko'radi, chunki u do'konda ishlaydi va narsalar sotadi. Bu qiyin.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli muharrir,

Men turizm haqida yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, turizm mahalliy jamiyatlar uchun ham yaxshi, ham yomon.

Misol uchun, turizm odamlarga ish o'rinlari berishi mumkin. Mehmonxonalar va restoranlarga ishchilar kerak. Shuningdek, sayyohlar do'konlarda pul sarflashadi. Bu iqtisodiyot uchun yaxshi. Biroq, turizm yomon ham bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zan sayyohlar juda ko'p bo'ladi va olomon yig'iladi. Bundan tashqari, sayyohlarda ko'proq pul bo'lgani uchun narxlar ko'tarilishi mumkin. Bu mahalliy aholi uchun narsalarni sotib olishni qiyinlashtiradi.

Menimcha, biz muvozanatni topishimiz kerak. Agar turizm yaxshi boshqarilsa, yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. Ammo agar u bunday bo'lmasa, muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,
Talaba
t2.uzSampleB2:
Muharrirga,

Men turizmning mahalliy jamiyatlarga ta'siri bo'yicha maqola tanloviga javoban yozyapman. Turizm, shubhasiz, iqtisodiy foyda keltirsa-da, uning ta'siri murakkab va ko'pincha o'zi ta'sir qilayotgan jamiyatlar uchun zararli bo'ladi.

Bir tomondan, turizm daromad va bandlikni yaratadi. Mahalliy bizneslar, suvenir do'konlaridan tortib restoranlargacha, turistlarning xarajatlari evaziga rivojlanadi. Ushbu pul oqimi infratuzilmani yaxshilashni moliyalashtirishi va mahalliy xizmatlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashi mumkin. Biroq, bu afzalliklar ko'pincha qimmatga tushadi. Turistlarning oqimi haddan tashqari gavjumlikka, resurslarning zo'riqishiga va atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, turistlarning didiga moslashish bosimi mahalliy madaniyatning tijoratlashtirilishiga, haqiqiy an'analarni sahnalashtirilgan tomoshalarga aylantirishga olib kelishi mumkin. Uy-joy narxlari ko'pincha oshadi, mahalliy aholini siqib chiqaradi va ularni ko'chib ketishga majbur qiladi. Turizmning uzoq muddatli barqarorligini hisobga olish muhim. Biz salbiy ta'sirlarni kamaytiradigan va mahalliy jamiyatlar turizmdan nafaqat qisqa muddatda, balki kelajak avlodlar uchun ham bevosita foyda olishini ta'minlaydigan mas'uliyatli amaliyotlarga ustuvor ahamiyat berishimiz kerak. To'g'ri tartibga solingan barqaror turizm muhim ahamiyatga ega.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirdagi talaba

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is learning the same language. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! Remember how we've both been struggling to practice Spanish speaking? I found this brilliant app called LingoConnect where you can video chat with native speakers! They help you and you help them with English. My confidence has improved so much. You should definitely try it! Buena suerte!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the language exchange app team. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear LingoConnect Team, Thank you for reaching out about my experience with your language exchange app. I have been using LingoConnect for two months and my speaking confidence has improved dramatically. The matching system connected me with friendly native speakers who patiently correct my mistakes. The video call quality is excellent, making conversations feel natural. However, I would like to suggest some improvements. Firstly, adding a scheduling feature would help coordinate calls across different time zones. Currently, arranging suitable times through messages is inconvenient. Secondly, including conversation topic suggestions would help beginners who struggle to maintain discussions. I would also appreciate a text chat translation feature for moments when communication becomes difficult. Overall, LingoConnect has transformed my language learning journey, and I recommend it to all my classmates. Yours sincerely, Shahnoza Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi LingoConnect,


I like app. It is good. I talk to people. Video good. I want more friends. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello LingoConnect,


Thank you for the app. It is good, and I like it. I talk to people, and they are nice. But sometimes the video is bad. I want more people to talk to, and I want it to be easier to find them. Thank you.


Bye,


Shahnoza Salimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear LingoConnect Team,


Thank you for your email. I like using LingoConnect. It is helpful for my language learning. I think the matching system is good, and I have met some nice people. The video calls are usually okay, but sometimes the connection is not very good.


I have some ideas for improvements. Firstly, it would be useful to have a way to schedule calls more easily. Secondly, maybe you could add some suggested topics for conversation, because sometimes it is difficult to know what to talk about. Also, I think it would be good if there was a way to translate messages in the chat.


Overall, I am happy with the app. Thank you.


Sincerely,
Shahnoza Salimova
t12.sampleB2:
Dear LingoConnect Team,

Thank you for getting in touch about my experience with your language exchange app. I have been using it for the past two months, and on the whole I am delighted with it.

The matching system has paired me with friendly native speakers who share my interests, which makes our conversations flow naturally. The video call quality is generally reliable, and I have made real progress with my speaking.

That said, there are a few improvements I would suggest. Firstly, a built-in scheduling tool would make it far easier to arrange calls across different time zones, as sorting out times by message is rather awkward. Secondly, a library of conversation topics would give beginners something to fall back on when the chat dries up.

Overall, LingoConnect has transformed my learning, and I would happily recommend it.

Yours sincerely,
Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli LingoConnect jamoasi,

Sizning til almashish ilovangiz haqidagi tajribam yuzasidan murojaat qilganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men LingoConnect’dan ikki oydan beri foydalanib kelaman va mening gapirishdagi ishonchim keskin oshdi. Moslashtirish tizimi meni xatolarimni sabr bilan tuzatadigan do'stona ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar bilan bog'ladi. Video qo'ng'iroq sifati juda yaxshi, suhbatlar tabiiy tuyuladi.

Biroq, men ba'zi takliflarni kiritmoqchiman. Birinchidan, rejalashtirish funksiyasini qo'shish turli vaqt zonalarida qo'ng'iroqlarni muvofiqlashtirishga yordam beradi. Hozirda mos vaqtni xabarlar orqali kelishish noqulay. Ikkinchidan, suhbat mavzulari bo'yicha takliflarni kiritish muhokamalarni davom ettirishga qiynaladigan yangi boshlanuvchilarga yordam beradi.

Agar aloqa qiyinlashganda, matnli chatni tarjima qilish funksiyasini ham qadrlagan bo'lardim.

Umuman olganda, LingoConnect mening til o'rganishimni o'zgartirdi va men uni barcha sinfdoshlarimga tavsiya qilaman.

Hurmat bilan,

Shahnoza Salimova

Hurmatli LingoConnect jamoasi,


LingoConnect ilovasi bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida men bilan bog'langaningiz uchun rahmat. Men uni bir necha haftadan beri ishlatib kelmoqdaman va umuman olganda ijobiy tajriba deb topdim, garchi takomillashtirilishi mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi sohalar mavjud.


Moslashtirish tizimi meni mos til sheriklari bilan bog'lashda yetarlicha samarali bo'ldi va video qo'ng'iroq sifati odatda qoniqarli. Biroq, men shuni payqadimki, moslashtirish algoritmi har doim ham o'xshash qiziqishlari yoki til o'rganish maqsadlari bo'lgan foydalanuvchilarga ustuvor ahamiyat bermaydi. Agar bu jihat takomillashtirilsa, foydali bo'lardi.


Bundan tashqari, o'rnatilgan jadval tuzish vositasi suhbat vaqtlarini tashkil qilish jarayonini sezilarli darajada soddalashtiradi, chunki hozirda u noqulay o'zaro xabarlashuvga tayanadi. Suhbatni boshlash va davom ettirishda qiynaladigan yangi boshlanuvchilar uchun suhbat boshlovchilari yoki taklif etilgan mavzular kutubxonasiga ega bo'lish ham foydali bo'lardi.


Nihoyat, muhim bo'lmasa-da, chat interfeysida real vaqtda matn tarjima qilish funksiyasi vaqti-vaqti bilan aloqa to'siqlarini bartaraf etishda bebaho bo'lishi mumkin.


Vaqtingiz va e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Shahnoza Salimova
